entry.title: notes on queues
entry.content:
Short post: queues is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Queues shows up across backend work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
